Dan DeVos is an American businessman and sports executive.
Dan DeVos was born around 1959.
Dan DeVos's father is Helen June (Van Wesep).
Dan DeVos's father is Richard DeVos, co-founder of Amway.
Since 1993, Dan DeVos has served as president and CEO of DP Fox Ventures in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
DP Fox owns and operates Fox Motors, Fox Harley-Davidson, and Fox Powersports dealerships in Michigan and the Chicago area.
The Fox companies represent 41 brands at 28 locations.
Dan DeVos was a finalist for the National Automobile Dealer Association's Dealer of the Year award in 2017.
Dan DeVos is a partner in CWD Real Estate Investment in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
CWD Real Estate Investment manages 3.2 million square feet of real estate in western Michigan, including several downtown properties.
CWD Real Estate Investment is downtown Grand Rapids' largest property owner.
Dan DeVos previously served as vice president of corporate affairs at Amway.
Dan DeVos previously served as vice president of the Pacific region at Amway.
Dan DeVos previously served as vice president of North America distributor relations at Amway.
Dan DeVos previously served as director of U.S. special events at Amway.
Dan DeVos currently serves on Amway's board of directors.
Dan DeVos is chairman of the Orlando Magic, an NBA team, since 2011.
At the Orlando Magic's 2018 media day, Dan DeVos spoke about strong community support for the team since the DeVos family purchased it in 1991.
Dan DeVos is the majority owner, president, and CEO of the Grand Rapids Griffins, an AHL team.
The Grand Rapids Griffins won the Calder Cup championship in 2013.
The Grand Rapids Griffins won the Calder Cup championship again in 2017.
After winning the 2017 Calder Cup, Dan DeVos spoke with the Grand Rapids Press.
Under Dan DeVos's ownership, the Grand Rapids Rampage of the Arena Football League won Arena Bowl XV in 2001.
The Grand Rapids Rampage defeated the Nashville Kats in the 2001 Arena Bowl, winning 64-42.
Dan DeVos currently serves on the board of directors for the West Michigan Sports Commission.
Dan DeVos is a member of the board of trustees at Northwood University (Midland, MI).
Dan DeVos is vice chairman of the executive committee for the Grand Valley State University Foundation (Allendale, MI).
Dan DeVos is a member of the board of trustees for the Hope Network Foundation.
